lines.zh: 我一步跨过你两步的距离。
lines.en: My single stride spans two of your paces.

lines.zh: 我走路没有声音，只有风。
lines.en: My walking makes no sound, only wind.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，也追不上我的走。
lines.en: Even sprinting, you cannot match my walk.
The grass parts itself beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我穿过树林，鸟都不叫了。
lines.en: I cross the woods and the birds go silent.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你的奔跑一样快。
lines.en: My stride keeps pace with your sprint.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我已经近了十步。
lines.en: When you look back, I am ten steps closer.
I walk steadily and never breathe hard.

lines.zh: 这片林子我认得每一棵树。
lines.en: I know every tree in these woods.
Do not count my steps; you will lose track.

lines.zh: 我靠近时，火把会暗一点。
lines.en: When I approach, torches dim a little.
I cast no shadow; check the ground.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一根烧焦的树。
lines.en: I stand still like a burnt tree.
I do not move, yet I keep watching you.
The wind stopped; I am still here.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，不差这一会。
lines.en: I have waited long; a while more is nothing.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不眨，也不需要眨。
lines.en: My eyes do not blink and need not.

lines.zh: 夜里最安静的时候，我醒着。
lines.en: In the quietest hour of night, I am awake.
While you sleep, I stand outside your door.
This body has no use for rest.
I tally every breath still inside you.

lines.zh: 沉默比说话更吓人，对吧。
lines.en: Silence frightens more than speech, does it not?
My eyes are two white lamps.
You recognize this face, do you not?
Do not blink; I will move closer.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里看见自己了吗？
lines.en: Do you see yourself in my eyes?

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一块待挖的矿。
lines.en: I look at you like unmined ore.
Your torch cannot light up my face.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，连呼吸的节奏。
lines.en: I have memorized you, even your breathing.

lines.zh: 这张脸你在噩梦里见过。
lines.en: You have seen this face in a nightmare.
I do not smile because I cannot.

lines.zh: 你越看，越觉得熟悉，对吧。
lines.en: The longer you look, the more familiar I get.

lines.zh: 你的剑卡在我的骨头里。
lines.en: Your blade is stuck in my bone.
I have little blood left to spill.
That hit weighed less than three centuries.
It hurts, but I will stand again.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，我记住你的手。
lines.en: You struck me; I remember your hands.
My flesh dried out long ago.
Three hundred points. Can you cut them all?
You actually wounded me. Truly.
This body of mine is hard to kill.
Retreat; you have been brave enough.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我早不饿了。
lines.en: Food is useless; hunger left me centuries ago.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，像举着诱饵。
lines.en: You hold out bread like bait.
Something else keeps me upright.

lines.zh: 这东西填不满三百年的空。
lines.en: This cannot fill three hundred empty years.
Feed me and I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃，也能一直走。
lines.en: I need no food and still never stop.

lines.zh: 麦子的味道，离我很远了。
lines.en: The smell of wheat is far behind me.
Put it away; I will not pretend.
Would you trade food for your life?
I have tasted it; it tastes like ash.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞上一块冰。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a block of ice.
My hands are cold; do not touch them.
You stepped back. That was wise.

lines.zh: 碰撞没有声音，你不觉得怪吗？
lines.en: The impact made no sound. Strange, is it not?

lines.zh: 我这具身体比看起来重。
lines.en: This body is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 你撞得我退了一步，仅此一次。
lines.en: You pushed me back one step. Only once.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我身上没有温度。
lines.en: Do not press close; I give off no warmth.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到了不该碰的东西。
lines.en: Your shoulder touched something it should not.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，是你自己撞来的。
lines.en: I stood still; you walked into me.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我量出了你的斤两。
lines.en: You bumped me, and I measured your worth.

lines.zh: 我这样的东西，没有后代。
lines.en: A thing like me leaves no offspring.

lines.zh: 三百年了，我从没想过这事。
lines.en: Three hundred years, and never once this.
You want to stay with me? You will regret it.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我只会带来夜晚。
lines.en: Stay away; I bring only night.

lines.zh: 与我作伴，等于搬进坟墓。
lines.en: My company means moving into a grave.
That is not why I exist.

lines.zh: 我的名字，早被林子吞了。
lines.en: The forest swallowed my name long ago.

lines.zh: 孤独对我来说，不算惩罚。
lines.en: Solitude is no punishment to me.

lines.zh: 你找错对象了，我只是个影子。
lines.en: Wrong choice; I am only a shadow.

lines.zh: 我从没碰过活人，除了杀。
lines.en: I never touched a living soul except to kill.
I will keep this as a memento.
I will hold that dropped thing for you.
Diamonds? I only drop those when I die.
I take it so your hands stay empty.

lines.zh: 这颅骨上的裂纹，是我敲的。
lines.en: I made that crack in this skull.
Your belongings belong to the night now.

lines.zh: 我把它放进没有底的袋子。
lines.en: I drop it into a bag with no bottom.
Pick it up and return it? I will not.

lines.zh: 这上面的名字，是我写的。
lines.en: The name on this was written by me.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，早晚都是我的。
lines.en: Everything on the ground becomes mine eventually.
I found you; do not stop breathing.
Run if you like; I do not walk slowly.
I have watched you since you were born.
Tonight I chase exactly one person.
I knew your name before you spoke.
Do not look back; your legs will fail.

lines.zh: 我扫过整片营地，只留下你。
lines.en: I swept the whole camp and kept only you.

lines.zh: 火把一灭，白眼睛就亮了。
lines.en: The torch dies and the white eyes light.

lines.zh: 我锁定你的方式，是记住味道。
lines.en: I lock on by remembering your scent.
Fleeing until dawn will not help you.
I am behind you. I always have been.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步了吗？那是我的。
lines.en: Heard footsteps? Those were mine.
This time I will not let you go.

lines.zh: 目标确认，你比上次瘦了。
lines.en: Target confirmed; you are thinner than last time.

lines.zh: 我把火把一根根掐灭，只剩下你。
lines.en: I pinch out each torch, leaving only you.
I breathe at the back of your neck.
I raise my hand; one blow is enough.
Forty-five points; enough to lay you down.
My bare hands suffice; I never carry a blade.
You back off three steps; I need one.

lines.zh: 我的速度和你奔跑一样。
lines.en: My speed matches your sprint.

lines.zh: 阳光杀不死我，你更不行。
lines.en: Sunlight cannot kill me. Neither can you.
I am waiting for you to raise your guard.
This blow will be frighteningly quiet.
I am calculating the angle you will fall.

lines.zh: 你的动作，我早看过一遍。
lines.en: I have seen your move before.
Keep your eyes open; I want them watching.
My patience outlasts this whole night.

lines.zh: 这双手杀过很多人，不缺你。
lines.en: These hands killed many; you will not be missed.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我慢慢走过去。
lines.en: You back into the corner; I walk over slowly.
I raise my hand, and your shadow trembles first.
The moment you stop, the distance is gone.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，我的步幅够长。
lines.en: I don't run. My stride is long enough.

lines.zh: 一下，四十五点，安静收场。
lines.en: One blow, forty-five points, quiet ending.
You fly back and snap a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 护甲挡不住我，像纸挡风。
lines.en: Armor does not stop me, no more than paper stops wind.
Does it hurt? I no longer remember.
When you fell, the grass made no sound.
I struck once; be grateful for that.
This palm print lands on your chest.
Your bones are far too brittle.
I barely pushed and you were airborne.
The blood is warm; that surprises me.
One motion of my hand and your breath ends.
In my hands you are like paper.
I practiced this strike in my dreams.
Do not scream; sound carries far at night.

lines.zh: 我的指节陷进你的护甲。
lines.en: My knuckles sink through your armor.
You didn't even finish the shout.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，没声音。
lines.en: I walk out of the mist, utterly silent.
Night has come; so have I.

lines.zh: 你点着火把，我还是来了。
lines.en: You lit a torch, and still I came.
These woods are mine tonight.
I stand beside your spawn point.
That white glow far off is my eye.
The rain stopped just as I arrived.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声叹息，是我。
lines.en: That sigh you heard was mine.

lines.zh: 我从地底最黑的地方爬上来。
lines.en: I climbed up from the blackest depth below.
This body has been dead for many years.
The door stayed shut; I am already inside.
You look up; there is nobody in the tree.
When I appear, even dogs stop barking.
Another night, another quarry.
Fire clings to me and does not burn through.
I fell from above and landed upright.

lines.zh: 水底很安静，我不想上去。
lines.en: The bottom is quiet; I may stay here.

lines.zh: 爆炸吹散了我一半的皮。
lines.en: The blast stripped off half my skin.
The arrow passes through me like fog.

lines.zh: 你的咒语在我身上哑了。
lines.en: Your spell died on my skin.

lines.zh: 饥饿这东西，我戒了三百年。
lines.en: I quit hunger three hundred years ago.
Lightning struck, and I took it.
The void waits below, and I do not fear it.
